text:
alexa: Starting v2 regional rollout to eu-central. Small canary (5%) then 20%. Watch client-signal headers and pinlists.

deploybot: Rollout scheduled: id r-eu-042, start 7301234580, initial 5%. Pause if errors >1% or p95 >2x baseline.

matt: Quick note 10 - we recently changed pin reconciliation to prefer control-plane state over edge cache to speed convergence. Theres a window where edge proxies still route pinned tenants to v1 while control-plane thinks they're pinned to v1 too, but the deploybot calls a reconcile job that flips routing if control-plane != edge. Watch for reconciliation flips during cutover.

nina: Got it. I'll watch per-tenant route mappings and the reconcile log.

ops-oncall: Canary started at 7301234580. Initial telemetry: p95 stable, errors 0.2%. No obvious issues yet.

deploybot: Canary progressed to 20% at 7301234595.

nina: Seeing a strange diff for tenant-90c: control-plane shows pinned=v1, but one eu-central edge shard reports routing=v2. Small traffic (~0.1%) but getting 4xx client-signal mismatches from that shard.

matt: That's not expected. Reconcile job should not flip routing if control-plane is v1. Investigating reconcile logs.

ops-oncall: Alert: client-signal mismatch errors spiking for tenant-90c at 7301234602. Localized but actionable.

alexa: Pause rollout. deploybot, freeze all reconciles and pin tenant-90c + tenant-a1e back to v1 at the edge. Also set deploybot to skip cross-region reconcile for 10m.

deploybot: Executing commands:
```
/deploy pause r-eu-042
/deploy freeze-reconciles 10m r-eu-042
/deploy pin tenant-90c v1 --edge
/deploy pin tenant-a1e v1 --edge
```
Freeze and pins applied; canary paused at 7301234610.

matt: Root cause: a race in the reconcile worker where duplicate reconciliation messages from controller loop (one older, one newer) were processed out-of-order on a shard that had slight clock skew. The older msg had routing=v2, so it overwrote the correct v1 state on that shard. Patch in PR #1298 adds monotonic version checks.

nina: Confirmed: the affected shard shows reconcile timestamp older than controller state, and the overwrite happened right when canary traffic ramped.

ops-oncall: After edge pinback, tenant-90c errors dropped to baseline. No other tenants affected.

alexa: Matt, can you backport the monotonic-guard to the edge-reconcile service and run a canary only for reconcile jobs (low-risk) to validate? We want a separate canary window for reconcile logic before resuming the traffic rollout.

matt: Yep. Cutting `reconcile-v1.0.1-hotfix-2`. Will deploy to a small set of reconcile workers and monitor for 15m.

release-notes-bot: Draft created: "v2 rollout paused due to cross-region reconcile race causing a small set of edge shards to misapply routing for pinned tenants. Hotfix reconcile-v1.0.1-hotfix-2 applied to reconcile workers; affected tenants pinned to v1 during mitigation."

nina: Operational plan: 1) deploy hotfix to reconcile canaries; 2) validate routing idempotence for 15m; 3) unfreeze reconciles and re-run a full pin audit; 4) resume v2 traffic rollout with an additional hold at 10%.

ops-oncall: Validation step 1 in progress. No regressions observed so far.

alexa: Also please add a small FAQ entry in release notes for customers: "If you saw client-signal mismatch 4xx during the eu cutover, you were likely impacted by a transient reconcile race; we pinned affected tenants to v1 and applied a hotfix. No data loss; please reach out to support if you continue to see issues."

matt: Hotfix deployed to reconcile-canaries at 7301234620. Monitoring for 15m.

ops-oncall: Will open a follow-up postmortem if we see further spread. For now closing this thread once reconcile canary validated.

alexa: Thanks team. After canary green, we'll re-run the staged rollout with the extra reconcile-only canary step in the operator playbook.
